The `m3e-nav-rail` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Modes

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.Element.NavRail.component [ M3e.Attributes.id "nav-rail" ]
[ M3e.Element.IconButton.component
{ content = M3e.Element.Icon.component [ M3e.Element.Icon.name "menu" ] []
, ariaLabel = "Toggle navigation"
, action = M3e.Action.none
}
[ M3e.Element.IconButton.toggle True ]
[ M3e.Element.IconButton.selected (M3e.Element.Icon.component [ M3e.Element.Icon.name "menu_open" ] [])
, M3e.Element.NavRailToggle.component [ M3e.Element.NavRailToggle.for "nav-rail" ] []
]
, M3e.Element.Fab.component
{ content = M3e.Element.Icon.component [ M3e.Element.Icon.name "edit" ] []
, action = M3e.Action.none
}
[ M3e.Element.Fab.size M3e.Values.small ]
[ M3e.Element.Fab.label (M3e.text "Extended") ]
, M3e.Element.NavItem.component []
[ M3e.Element.NavItem.icon (M3e.Element.Icon.component [ M3e.Element.Icon.name "news" ] [])
, M3e.text "News"
]
, M3e.Element.NavItem.component []
[ M3e.Element.NavItem.icon (M3e.Element.Icon.component [ M3e.Element.Icon.name "globe" ] [])
, M3e.text "Global"
]
, M3e.Element.NavItem.component []
[ M3e.Element.NavItem.icon (M3e.Element.Icon.component [ M3e.Element.Icon.name "star" ] [])
, M3e.text "For you"
]
, M3e.Element.NavItem.component []
[ M3e.Element.NavItem.icon (M3e.Element.Icon.component [ M3e.Element.Icon.name "newsstand" ] [])
, M3e.text "Trending"
]
]

component is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the component surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for component on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

build is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the build surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for build on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

<m3e-nav-rail id="nav-rail">
<m3e-icon-button aria-label="Toggle navigation" toggle="">
<m3e-icon name="menu"></m3e-icon>
<m3e-icon slot="selected" name="menu_open"></m3e-icon>
<m3e-nav-rail-toggle for="nav-rail"></m3e-nav-rail-toggle>
</m3e-icon-button>
<m3e-fab size="small">
<m3e-icon name="edit"></m3e-icon>
<span slot="label">Extended</span>
</m3e-fab>
…
<m3e-nav-item><m3e-icon slot="icon" name="news"></m3e-icon>News</m3e-nav-item>
<m3e-nav-item><m3e-icon slot="icon" name="globe"></m3e-icon>Global</m3e-nav-item>
<m3e-nav-item><m3e-icon slot="icon" name="star"></m3e-icon>For you</m3e-nav-item>
<m3e-nav-item><m3e-icon slot="icon" name="newsstand"></m3e-icon>Trending</m3e-nav-item>
</m3e-nav-rail>

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-nav-rail produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type Mode

The mode values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).
